about: Khmelnytskyi: a trading city with new districts

Khmelnytskyi is known as a major trading hub of Podillia, with many entrepreneurs, shops and warehouses. Its housing is Soviet-era estates, new residential complexes and a private sector on the Southern Bug.

So besides apartments and houses we often talk about commercial premises: a shop, a showroom, an office. For those there is [commercial renovation](/en/commercial-renovation) and [turnkey business premises](/en/business-fit-out), with invoices for companies.

For apartments — a family layout, a kitchen-living room, walk-in wardrobes; for shops and showrooms — customer flow, displays and lighting on the goods. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments, houses, offices and shops: offices from $350 per m² (works and rough materials). Near Khmelnytskyi we build aerated-block, brick and timber-frame houses; project, shell, finishing and furnishing can go under one contract or in stages.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
